subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core session-level process/step event contract, and if so what taxonomy, retention, replay, authorization, and redaction rules should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the permanent public API shape and security boundary cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Design Core Process Events
options.body: Define an additive gateway/protocol/SDK contract for `process.*` and `step.*` events with stable ids, replay bounds, and redacted payload rules before queueing implementation.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Progress Items
options.body: Keep this broad issue open but prioritize related narrower surfaces such as inter-session progress, Control UI Codex progress, or CLI stdout streaming first.

options.title: Reject Core Process Events
options.body: Close this direction after deciding existing `agent`/`session.tool`/SDK events are the supported observability model and document that clients must consume those instead.

recommendation.title: Design Core Process Events
recommendation.body: Define an additive gateway/protocol/SDK contract for `process.*` and `step.*` events with stable ids, replay bounds, and redacted payload rules before queueing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is on the agent-event and gateway protocol surfaces where the product/security contract would be decided.
